user.title: Connect Electrolux / AEG
user.description:
How to get your credentials (one-time, ~3 minutes):

1. Open the Electrolux developer portal: {dashboard}
2. Sign in — with the **same account as the Electrolux/AEG app** (where your appliances are).
3. Copy your **API Key** (in the dashboard under "API Keys").
4. Generate a token pair there ("Generate token" / "Authorize") and copy the **Access Token** and **Refresh Token**.

Have all three values? Then tap "Next" below.

menu_options.credentials: Next — I have API Key, Access & Refresh token

credentials.title: Enter credentials
credentials.description: Paste the three values from the portal. They stay only in your Home Assistant.

data_description.access_token: The short-lived token from the pair you just generated.
data_description.refresh_token: The long token from the same pair — it renews itself automatically from now on.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Electrolux / AEG
reauth_confirm.description:
Your tokens have expired (rare). Get fresh ones quickly:

1. Open {dashboard} and sign in.
2. Generate a **new** token pair (Access + Refresh token).
3. Your **API Key** can be reused unchanged.

Ready? Then tap "Next".

reauth_credentials.title: Re-authenticate — enter tokens
reauth_credentials.description: Paste the freshly generated values. The API Key can stay the same.

data_description.api_key: Same as before (or a new one from "API Keys").
data_description.access_token: The short-lived token from the new pair.
data_description.refresh_token: The long token from the new pair.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the API key, access and refresh token — best to generate fresh ones in the portal.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Electrolux API. Please try again later.

abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication successful — your appliances are connected again.
abort.wrong_account: These tokens belong to a different Electrolux account than the one being re-authenticated. Use tokens from the same account.

init.title: Options
init.description: The Electrolux Developer API is rate-limited. Intervals below 120 seconds may cause errors.
